Truth map for Phase 1 of report 17. Every claim carries a `file:line` in this repository at `a29b8ab`
(branch `feature/session-orchestration`) or a quoted line from `claude --help` (CLI 2.1.283).

## Where the spec met the code and lost (resolved; spec amended 2026-09-27)

| Assumption | Reality | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| Ledger under `~/.cache/hefesto/ledger/<sha1>` | The sandbox write allowlist is `.`, `$TMPDIR`, `/tmp/claude`; `~/.cache` is not writable from the Bash tool (`precompact-progress.sh:20-21` writes it from a hook, outside the sandbox) | Ledger in the **git common dir**: `$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/hefesto/ledger/<id>.json` — shared by all worktrees, never committed, not under `.claude/`, under `.`; `HEFESTO_LEDGER_DIR` override for tests |
| Workers write the ledger | A worker runs inside `.claude/worktrees/<id>`; the common dir is outside its sandbox root | Only the launcher writes; workers/verifiers report via `--json-schema` structured output |
| `claude rm <id>` cleans the worktree | `rm` takes the id `--bg` prints; a plain `-p -w` run has none | Cleanup is `git worktree remove` after merge, human step in Phase 1 |
| `.claude/project-status.json` is trackable | `~/.gitignore_global:1` ignores `.claude/`; existing `.claude/CLAUDE.md` is tracked only because it was force-added | `git add -f` (the standing convention for `.claude/CLAUDE.md`) |
| "17 hook scripts" | 15 registered hooks (`hooks/hooks.json`) + helpers `release.sh`, `speckit-helper.sh`, `status-board.sh`; docs say "41 subcommands", the script has 42 arms | Docs: "fifteen hooks" unchanged; helper list gains `ledger.sh`, `session-launch.sh`; 41 → 42 |
| `--settings` JSON is checked | `-p` help: "Settings files that fail validation are silently ignored in this mode" | Launcher validates with `jq -e` before launch; mutation-tested |
| Smoke helpers `check/ok/fail` | `ok()`, `bad()`, `head_()` at `tests/smoke.sh:27-29` | Use those |

## Relevant Symbols

- `hooks/status-board.sh:109-120` — `column_items`: id = first `id_pattern` match anywhere in the heading; marker = first token unless id-like; text = heading minus `#`s. For `## HEF-1 — title`: id `HEF-1`, marker empty. Bodies are never printed; `--item` must read the column file between the heading and the next heading.
- `hooks/status-board.sh:206-207` — detailed item line: six spaces, id padded to 16, marker padded to 4, text truncated at 70. The orchestrator parses ids from column 1 under the `  todo` header.
- `hooks/status-board.sh:56` — `cfg()` reads only named keys, so an `orchestrate` block in the same file is ignored by the board and free for the launcher.
- `hooks/speckit-helper.sh:212-215` — `check-plan-review` greps `^## Reviewed` in `plan.md`: the evidence `ledger unblock human:plan-review` reuses.
- `hooks/session-start-context.sh:47-51` — checkpoint line shape `last checkpoint (<when>): <path> — …`; the ledger line follows the same "one fact per line" style.
- `tests/smoke.sh:725` — `grep -vE '<[a-z-]+>'` skips command invocations with placeholders in live Tier 2: `/hef.orchestrate` must write `ledger.sh claim <id>` with a placeholder, never a literal id.
- `claude --help` — `-p` ("Settings files that fail validation are silently ignored"), `-w, --worktree [name]`, `-n, --name`, `--settings <file-or-json>`, `--allowedTools`/`--disallowedTools` ("Bash(git *) Edit"), `--permission-mode` choices `acceptEdits|auto|bypassPermissions|manual|dontAsk|plan`, `--permission-prompts host|none` ("none: anything that would prompt is denied automatically"), `--max-budget-usd` (print only), `--output-format text|json|stream-json`, `--json-schema`, `--model` (alias or full name), `--effort`, `--bare` (skips hooks — **never** for workers), `--resume`, `--continue`, `--fork-session`, `--forward-subagent-text` (exists; forbidden on the verifier). **No `--max-turns`.** Settings enum in the binary: `crossSessionInbound: accept|hold|refuse`; `sandbox.failIfUnavailable`, `total_cost_usd`, `structured_output` present.
- `git 2.55.0` — `rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir` supported; from a `-w` worktree it returns the main `.git`.

## Existing Patterns & Conventions

- Helper contract: FETCHER prints on stdout at exit 0 or the reason on stderr at non-zero; PREDICATE prints and returns; `die()` to stderr (`speckit-helper.sh:6-39`, `status-board.sh:15,22`). Unknown flag exits 2 (`status-board.sh:31`).
- Commands run helpers with the Bash tool via `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/<x>.sh`, never `!` blocks (`hef.status.md:14-24`); on failure they run `--check` and stop (`hef.status.md:24-27`).
- Tiers only in frontmatter, never a model id (`docs/architecture.md:47`); `hef.pr` is `sonnet` because it dispatches (`hef.pr.md:1`).
- Smoke: capture output into a variable, then `grep -q <<<`; never `producer | grep -q` (`smoke.sh:31-39`). Mutation checks recorded as comments above the assertion (`smoke.sh:815-820, 1300`). Fixtures in `mktemp -d` git repos; a fake `gh` on `PATH` records argv (`smoke.sh:1345-1367`).
- Eval seeding rule: cases come from real failures; a case that passes without the plugin is kept only as a regression guard and says so (`evals/README.md:40-48`). `tool_used max: 0` graders survive the eval sandbox's `git` denial (`evals/README.md:27-32`).
- Untrusted input: delimited block `<<<untrusted-begin … untrusted-end>>>`, strip `<!-- -->`, stop if it names a tool/file/command (`hef.pr.md:29-39`).
- `.claude/CLAUDE.md` is tracked via `git add -f` against the global ignore; same for the new config.

## Open Questions

- Branch protection: `gh api repos/joaoariedi/hefesto/branches/main/protection` → `404 Branch not protected`. The structural gate the user chose does not exist yet. Recommended setting: "require a pull request before merging" with 0 required approvals and admins included — blocks any direct push to `main` by a launched session without blocking the user's own merge-via-PR flow. Outward change → user decision at plan review.
- The structured-output field name on `--output-format json` (`structured_output` per the binary strings) is confirmed on the first real run (SC-002); the launcher reads `.structured_output // .result` and fails loudly if neither parses.
